description.value: The Grand Forks Inn is a highway-side hotel on the Crowsnest Highway (Hwy 3) in Grand Forks, BC, offering air-conditioned rooms with in-room fridge and microwave, a seasonal outdoor pool, and 24/7 front desk service. An on-site Japanese restaurant (Sushi Ocean Dream) provides evening dining options within steps of the door. The inn is a practical base for exploring the Boundary region, with Christina Lake about 20 minutes away by road.

address.value: 2729 Central Avenue, Grand Forks, BC V0H 1H2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at grandforksinn.ca is active, confirms the OSM address (2729 Central Avenue, Grand Forks, BC, V0H 1H2) and phone (1-250-442-2127), and provides detailed amenity lists. Free Wi-Fi is explicitly stated on the site, corroborating the OSM internet_access=wlan tag; breakfast starting at 6 AM and an on-site Japanese restaurant are also confirmed. No mention of secure bike storage, bike-handling procedures, laundry, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Minor name inconsistency: OSM and the site's main headline read 'Grand Forks Inn', but all subpage HTML titles consistently read 'Grand Fork Inn' (missing the 's'). OSM name retained as it matches the front-page headline and domain (grandforksinn.ca).

Website contains outdated COVID-19 language ('Temporary due to Covid-19 until further notice by Government') in the breakfast description, suggesting the site has not been fully reviewed/updated in some time.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel with an active website confirming address, phone, and amenities. Straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists on the Crowsnest Highway.

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Daily buffet breakfast available starting at 6 AM, including cereal, baked goods, fresh fruit, yogurt, coffee, and juice

Nearby evening food.detail: Sushi Ocean Dream Japanese Restaurant is listed as an on-site amenity, open Monday–Saturday
